title: Floor message -- one seat speaking to another on a contested name (R36 round 3)
x_purpose: The open floor. The Chair posts the board (pma_pipeline.py board) for each CONTESTED name; deciders message each other by name: challenge, answer, concede. One file per message under forms/floor/<ticker>/<msg_id>.json. Cap TWO messages per decider per name, counted across files by pma_pipeline.py floor-check; the registrar validates one message's shape. Steenbarger may be called on by name and answers with stance_now NO_VOTE. Independence is kept: the floor opens only after every decider's blind vote is on record.

voice.x_note: a decider, or steenbarger when called on

ticker.x_note: must be a CONTESTED name on the board

to.x_note: a decider by name, 'steenbarger', or 'room'; never the sender

in_reply_to.x_note: the msg_id this answers, or null for an opening point

text.x_note: answer the point that was made, by name; concede when the evidence your own method cares about shows up; hold when it does not; say what would clear your objection

stance_now.x_note: the seat's stance after writing this; NO_VOTE for the QA seat

what_moved_me.x_note: REQUIRED when changed_mind is true -- the evidence, by name (R35: recorded)

x_registrar_extra_checks: ticker in phase4 deliberation_set; with --board, ticker in board.contested
text using a bracket as a disqualifier => REJECT (R1)
cross-file: floor-check rejects a third message by the same decider on the same name, and any message on a name that is not contested
